financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of common stock under the 2023 Sales Agreement in January 2026 (exact day not stated; month-end used)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In January 2026, pursuant to the 2023 Sales Agreement, the Company issued and sold an aggregate of 2,940,452 shares of its common stock, resulting in net proceeds of $ 20.8 million.

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Hercules loan tranche 3 drawdown under the Third Amendment
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: a third amendment was made to the Company's Loan Agreement (the "Third Amendment") with Hercules on January 29, 2026 pursuant to which the Company drew down the tranche 3 loan advance amount of $ 35.0 million.
